summary: LivePerson (target) filed an 8-K announcing an amended merger agreement with SoundHound AI (acquirer) to acquire LivePerson via a two-step merger. The amendment changes consideration for TASE shares from SoundHound common stock to cash to avoid Israeli securities law delays. No price per share or premium is disclosed in the excerpt. The board's recommendation is not stated. The structure involves two merger subsidiaries merging into LivePerson, which will survive as a SoundHound subsidiary. Watch for regulatory approvals in Israel and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on potential TASE shareholder reaction.
